purpose: Reviewable logical examples and negative-case inventory for WS3 TaskClaim/LeaseRenewal/TaskResult, cancellation settlement and WS8 envelope mapping. This file is not a JSON Schema, is not executable by itself and contains no accepted cryptographic vector.

authenticator.note: NOT A SIGNATURE; no authority is granted by this fixture

command.note: Replace with exact CommandRequest golden bytes only after W3/W2 agree its canonicalization profile

lease_renewal_receipt_candidate.note: EXPECTED SHAPE ONLY; current W3 LeaseRenewal does not return these binding/receipt fields

task_result_candidate.digest_note: Current W3 adapter converts the typed event to serde_json::Value, then Runalith content_hash serializes that Value with serde_json::to_vec; it is not W8 envelope payload_digest. Golden canonical bytes not approved.

cancellation_projection_candidate.note: HTTP ACK, local cgroup populated-zero observation, timeout and lease expiry do not prove provider terminality or settle an executing workflow

negative_cases.mutation: claim.schema_version=999
no authenticated host producer context
claim.audience != authenticated worker identity
claim.expires_at <= trusted now
claim.attempt=0 or claim.owner_epoch=0
claim omits acl_sha256 and no approved signed nested equivalent exists
command bytes changed without command_sha256 and authenticator change
nested provider_dispatch/session_messages changed under same claim identity
plan_sha256, lease_id or owner_epoch differs from current Control authority
same renewal_id and exact request sent again after first commit
same renewal_id but changed lease_seconds, claim or subject
if a retry path is introduced, retry after an ambiguous send allocates a new renewal_id instead of reusing the persisted logical heartbeat ID and exact request
renewal references expired/superseded lease or wrong worker/attempt/epoch
receipt omits renewal_id, claim_id, previous expiry or receipt identity
same event_id/idempotency and exact event digest
same event_id/idempotency with changed event digest
result has stale lease or owner_epoch
Control inbox accepts event whose external evidence has not been independently verified
cancellation request returns HTTP success but execution may have started
local ProcessStopReceiptV1 has no authenticated producer verifier
local cgroup populated-zero observed while provider outcome is ambiguous
event_sha256 copied into common envelope payload_digest without identical-byte proof
ordering.predecessor_id set to previous_sha256 instead of previous event_id
prior event row unavailable or bounded history incomplete

blocking_gaps: W3 TaskClaimEnvelope v3 source has no explicit acl_sha256 field; WS2/W3 must ratify exact field placement and signed bytes.

Current W3 heartbeat invokes renewal once per interval and fails closed on ambiguous/error; no same-heartbeat retry is implemented. ControlPlane has no caller-supplied logical renewal_id or exact retry path. LeaseRenewal omits renewal/claim identity, previous expiry, persisted time and durable receipt ID.
No production Control claim signer/verifier or W3 verifier configuration is proven.
W3 ProcessStopReceiptV1 is unsigned local cgroup-only observation; W4 provider terminal proof remains separate.
W2 has no approved TaskClaim/LeaseRenewal/TaskResult/Cancellation exact canonical-byte/hash golden vectors yet.
Named accountable WS2 producer and WS3 consumer owners remain UNASSIGNED.
